name: wtf
title_zh: 上线前先替你拆雷的 AI 项目体检员
tagline_zh: 提交前问一句「这能发吗」？它扫结构、密钥、迁移、鉴权，专治 AI 写代码留下的隐蔽坑。
tagline_en: Ask before you ship or commit. It sweeps structure, secrets, migrations, auth—catches AI-coded traps three layers.
desc_en: Pre-launch and pre-commit audit for vibe coding projects. Use when asked to check whether a project is ready to ship, deploy, merge, or commit, especially for common AI-built app mistakes: broken project structure, committed secrets or cache files, environment variable hygiene, database migrations, ORM/schema drift, unsafe raw SQL, unused legacy code, dead routes/components, weak auth, missing tes
why_zh: 不是泛泛的 lint，而是按「AI 项目常见死法」逐项盘查：密钥泄漏、ORM 漂移、死路由、弱鉴权。
why_en: Not a generic linter—it audits against known AI-project failure modes: leaked secrets, schema drift, dead routes, weak auth.
limit_zh: 只审代码仓库状态，不跑测试、不查运行时性能；对纯前端静态页或单文件脚本覆盖有限。
limit_en: Audits repo state only—no test runs, no runtime perf. Limited on static pages or single-file scripts; needs git history or readable structure, else.
title_en: Pre-launch auditor that defuses AI-coded landmines
